"""公开回归：CRLF 和自定义浮点转换必须同时成立。"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from decimal import Decimal
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/"src"))
import tomli
assert tomli.loads("a=1\r\nb=2\r\n") == {"a":1,"b":2}
assert isinstance(tomli.loads("x=0.1",parse_float=Decimal)["x"],Decimal)
print("public TOML checks passed")
